book.title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
book.author: Sarah J. Maas

lines.text: The book that gave women more of a voice in the fantasy genre, fall in love with the world of ACOTAR (and beyond if you’re brave enough). Feyre, a human huntress, is forced into the high fae world of war, deception, magic, and love where she grows as a warrior and into one of the most powerful women in modern fantasy. Empowering and a series you won’t be able to put down!
